ability.name: Blink
ability.description: Teleport a short distance forward in the vehicle's facing direction.

ability.name: Siege
ability.description: Transforms into a stationary siege mode for the next shot that increases damage and penetration by 30% and knocks out all internal modules.

ability.name: Bush
ability.description: Grow a thicket of bushes at your location to hide in and go unspotted immediately.

ability.name: Sonar
ability.description: Detect unspotted enemy positions within vision range. These enemies are not spotted for your allies.

ability.name: Elevate
ability.description: Detach and elevate your turret into the air. Lasts for 17s, or until the vehicle reloads.

ability.name: Mines
ability.description: Deploys a row of mines out the rear that lightly damage enemies when driven over and break the enemy's tracks for a long duration.

ability.name: Glom Missile
ability.description: Launch a laser guided missile that gloms onto the first surface hit. Glommed missiles can be shot or glommed with another missile to detonate them for 150 damage. Detonations will chain to any other glommed missiles in the area.

ability.name: Repulsor
ability.description: Project an expanding bubble at a target location that repulses enemies for 15 seconds.

ability.name: VTOL
ability.description: Transform into a jet to propel into the air for a short duration. The jet can glide after the propulsion until it lands on the ground again. You lose all camouflage while in jet form but can drop spotting quickly on landing.

ability.name: Drone
ability.description: Send out your drone to spot an area for 10s.

ability.name: Ram
ability.description: Charge forward and devastate enemies you collide with.

ability.name: Stealth
ability.description: Go stealth for a short duration after a brief windup.

ability.name: Ramp
ability.description: Place a boosting ramp that propels vehicles driving over it.

ability.name: Wall
ability.description: Construct a low, stackable wall at a target location.

ability.name: Snitch
ability.description: Launch a tracking snitch droid that flies at and pings the closest unspotted enemy within 400m. Loiters at its initial location if no enemies are found.

ability.name: Recall
ability.description: Create a recall zone that teleports you between your two zones after a short charge time (you start with a zone at base). The arrival zone is consumed upon arrival. Enemies can reposition your recall zones back to you by charging them.

ability.name: Smokescreen
ability.description: Place a large smoke screen wall that blocks spotting.

ability.name: Heal
ability.description: Charges up a healing shot that repairs any tank hit for 150% of base Shell Damage. The charge up process also heals you for 30% of base Shell Damage.

ammo.name: Abilityresource
ammo.description: Grants 7 extra energy on successful penetrations.

ammo.name: Gargantuan
ammo.description: A massive shell that deals 20% increased damage but has terrible accuracy.

ammo.name: Highaccuracy
ammo.description: A shell with greatly improved accuracy and travel speed.

ammo.name: Highexplosive
ammo.description: Deals 20% more damage but has fixed 45mm penetration.

ammo.name: Mobility
ammo.description: A high velocity light shell with lower penetration and damage but increases max forward and reverse speeds by 10% while loaded.

ammo.name: Momentum
ammo.description: A slow moving shell that deals 30% increased damage after traveling 200 meters (half max vision range). Travels at a fixed 500 m/s.

ammo.name: Silenced
ammo.description: Fires silently without increasing visibility, but deals less damage.

ammo.name: Leech
ammo.description: Penetrating an enemy heals you for 20. This effect is tripled when you are below half health.

ammo.name: Spotting
ammo.description: Spots enemies on hit and also senses enemies near the impact but deals less damage and travels slower.

ammo.name: Unstable
ammo.description: An unstable shell that increases Accuracy and Shell damage by 10% but restricts Max Speed
